responses.body_preview: eCourts Home function onCaptchaSolved() { document.getElementById('captcha_form').submit(); } WebCivil Supreme WebCivil Supreme provides online access to information about cases in Civil Supreme Court in all 62 counties of New York State. With our eTrack case tracking service you can receive email updates and appearance reminders for Civil Supreme Court cases.
